_about.weapons: the game's weapon tables (BOOT.BIN: melee 0x895A0DC, 24-byte records; bows and bowguns after it, 28-byte; model id at +16 -> weNNN). Names: the game's English text. The class is the model's: byte [0x089785A8 + model] (BOOT 0x0885CCD0), in the game's class order. Gun records: 0x08960CAC (item -> model, 0x08851F20).
